scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment entryway, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The localized interactions involve two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, a refrigerator door, an upper spice-cabinet door, and a lower utensil drawer.
